notes.title: Spooky Heroes updated
notes.content:
Hi all,

Another update to correct the bugs reported :

- The platforms now correctly explode in the swamp river stage
- The barbarian quest now correctly ends when the timer expires
- The player can no longer go outside of the stage when riding a dragon
- The player can't spam eating food anymore
- The ninja quest bug has been resolved. Players will need to defeat the Dragon Lord once more with this patch then proceed to the Snow Village.

Thanks for your feedback and patience !

notes.title: Spooky Heroes updated
notes.content:
Hi all,

Following players reports, I've updated the game to correct some bugs as well as optimizing the game to make the battle smoother. With this patch, most attacks should be faster to perform giving a better feeling to the game.

Here is the changelog :

Bug corrections :
- Corrected a bug which prevented the wall to clear when defeating the minotaur
- Corrected a bug which prevented enemies to spawn in the maze
- Corrected a bug which prevented the retry ambush if a rope was using to escape

Tweaks :
- Ambush quests now automatically end when timer reaches 0

Optimizations :
- Sped up most battle animations by 33%
- Added sprites preloading to reduce lag during play

Language fix :
- Corrected mistake in goblin names

On a side note, due to summer vacation, I was a bit delay to correct those bugs but will try my best to correct any future bugs encountered faster. So let me know if you notices any of them.

Thanks for your support !

notes.title: Spooky Heroes updated
notes.content:
Hi all,

Following player suggestions, a few things have been changed in the game :

- A key binding help has been added in the pause menu (Press Esc or Start)
- The camera is no longer locked when a rift spawns. However the bounty earned when destroying one should still be an incentive to actively focus on them.
- When dying against a boss, the player now respawns near its lair in easy and normal modes.

Those changes should make the game less of a hassle for new players and remove the camera problem with rifts.

I'm also aware of some problem with the Linux release, some backgrounds not showing or some black screen problem occurring. If such things happen to you, please, contact me with your configuration so I can correct that asap.

Thanks for your time !
